invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.09（基于ATR 0.0008和支撑），或融资费率Z-score进一步升高>120%（轧多风险加剧），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 $0.10）但需确认。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.09 (based on ATR 0.0008 and support), or funding Z-score increases further >120% (long squeeze risk intensifies), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 $0.10) but needs confirmation.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破78（基于ATR 0.8456和日线支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（轧多风险增加），或日线趋势进一步恶化（价格跌破关键支撑$78）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 78 (based on ATR 0.8456 and daily support), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (long squeeze risk increases), or daily trend worsens further (price breaks key support $78).
